questions.stem: In a survey of pet owners, 30% of the people who own a dog also own a cat, and 50% of the people who own a cat also own a dog. If 60 of the people surveyed own both a dog and a cat, how many of the people surveyed own exactly one of these two kinds of pets?

questions.subskill: Arc length from coordinates on a circle
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, points A(6, 0) and B(0, 6) lie on the circle x² + y² = 36. What is the length of the minor arc AB ?

questions.subskill: Area of a trapezoid
questions.stem: A trapezoid has parallel sides of lengths 7 centimeters and 13 centimeters, and the distance between the parallel sides is 5 centimeters. What is the area of the trapezoid, in square centimeters?

questions.subskill: Finding a constant from the sum of a line's intercepts
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the graph of 3x − 5y = k, where k is a positive constant, has an x-intercept and a y-intercept whose sum is 8. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Greatest whole number under a budget with a minimum purchase
questions.stem: Kim has $20 to spend on pens, which cost $1.25 each, and notebooks, which cost $3.50 each. She must buy at least 4 notebooks. What is the greatest number of pens she can buy?

questions.subskill: Point with related coordinates on a line
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the point (a, a + 3) lies on the line 2x + 5y = 29. What is the value of a ?

questions.subskill: Solving an equation with two square roots
questions.stem: What value of x satisfies the equation √(x + 9) − √x = 1 ?

questions.subskill: Time for a falling object to reach a height
questions.stem: An object is dropped from a height of 80 meters. Its height above the ground t seconds after it is dropped is h(t) = 80 − 5t² meters. How many seconds after it is dropped does the object reach the ground?

questions.subskill: Comparing exponential, polynomial and linear values
questions.stem: Which of the following functions has the greatest value at x = 10 ?

questions.subskill: Percent change in area from changes in two dimensions
questions.stem: The length of a rectangle is increased by 20%, and its width is decreased by 10%. Which of the following describes the change in the area of the rectangle?

questions.subskill: Cosine of an angle in the coordinate plane
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, triangle OPQ has vertices O(0, 0), P(8, 0) and Q(8, 6). What is the value of cos(∠POQ) ?

questions.subskill: Radius from an arc length and a radian angle
questions.stem: In a circle, a central angle of 2.5 radians intercepts an arc of length 15 centimeters. What is the radius of the circle, in centimeters?

questions.subskill: Volume of a rectangular box
questions.stem: A rectangular box measures 3 inches by 5 inches by 8 inches. What is the volume of the box, in cubic inches?

questions.subskill: Slope from a point and an x-intercept
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a line with slope m passes through the point (2, −1) and crosses the x-axis at x = 6. What is the value of m ?

questions.subskill: Sum of zeros from two values of a factored quadratic
questions.stem: The function p is defined by p(x) = (x − a)(x − b), where a and b are constants. If p(0) = 12 and p(1) = 6, what is the value of a + b ?

questions.subskill: Simplifying a product of conjugates plus a constant
questions.stem: Which of the following is equivalent to (x + 5)(x − 5) + 25 ?

questions.subskill: Minimum of a horizontally shifted quadratic
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = x² − 4x + 7, and g(x) = f(x + 3). Which of the following gives the minimum value of g and the value of x at which it occurs?

questions.subskill: Effect of sample size on the margin of error
questions.stem: A polling organization surveyed a random sample of 400 voters and reported a margin of error of 5 percentage points. Suppose it had instead surveyed a random sample of 1,600 voters chosen in the same way. Which of the following is most likely true about the margin of error for the larger sample?

choices.A: It would be larger than 5 percentage points.
choices.B: It would be exactly 5 percentage points.
choices.C: It would be exactly 20 percentage points.
choices.D: It would be smaller than 5 percentage points.

questions.subskill: Fuel remaining after a trip
questions.stem: A car's 14-gallon fuel tank is full. The car uses 1 gallon of fuel for every 32 miles it travels. How many gallons of fuel remain in the tank after the car travels 200 miles?

questions.subskill: Part from a part-to-part ratio and a difference
questions.stem: At a school, the ratio of the number of students who walk to school to the number who ride the bus is 2 to 3. There are 12 more students who ride the bus than students who walk. How many students walk to school?

questions.subskill: Exterior angle of a triangle
questions.stem: In triangle ABC, the exterior angle at vertex C measures 115°, and the measure of angle A is 48°. What is the measure of angle B ?

questions.subskill: Comparing volumes of a sphere and a cylinder
questions.stem: A sphere and a right circular cylinder each have a radius of 3 centimeters, and the cylinder is 4 centimeters tall. The volume of the sphere is k times the volume of the cylinder. What is the value of k ?

questions.subskill: Share of revenue from a subgroup
questions.stem: At a store, 40% of the customers are members and the rest are nonmembers. On average, a member spends $60 per visit and a nonmember spends $40 per visit. Assuming each customer makes one visit, what percent of the store's revenue comes from members? (Disregard the % sign when entering your answer.)

questions.subskill: Coefficients from the vertex of a parabola
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = ax² + 4x + c, where a and c are constants. The vertex of the graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane is (−1, 3). What is the value of a + c ?

questions.subskill: Value of a completed square from an equation
questions.stem: If x² + 6x = 7, what is the value of (x + 3)² ?

questions.subskill: Slope of a line through a given intersection point
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, the line y = mx + 2, where m is a constant, intersects the line y = 3x − 4 at a point whose x-coordinate is 2. What is the value of m ?

questions.subskill: Square with a perimeter equal to a circle's circumference
questions.stem: A circle has an area of 49π square centimeters. A square has a perimeter equal to the circumference of the circle. What is the side length of the square, in centimeters?

questions.subskill: Evaluating a linear function at a related input
questions.stem: The function f is defined by f(x) = −3x + 12. If f(k) = 0, what is the value of f(2k) ?

questions.subskill: Substituting into a linear relationship
questions.stem: If y = 3x and x = 7, what is the value of 2y ?

questions.subskill: Distributing a monomial over a binomial
questions.stem: Which of the following is equivalent to 2x(3x − 4) ?

questions.subskill: y-intercept from an x-intercept and another point
questions.stem: In the xy-plane, a line has an x-intercept of 4 and passes through the point (6, 5). What is the y-intercept of the line?

questions.subskill: Segment of the hypotenuse cut by the altitude
questions.stem: A right triangle has legs of lengths 9 and 12. The altitude drawn from the right angle to the hypotenuse divides the hypotenuse into two segments. What is the length of the shorter segment?
